email.subject: Quick fix for Dockside Works' site
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I looked at Dockside Works' website. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no way to book or request service online, so anyone searching after hours just leaves, and the site doesn't list your business hours, which makes people unsure if you're open and go to a competitor instead.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what's losing you customers and how to fix it?

Alex
Northlight Web
